transubstantiate.definition: v. change (the Eucharist bread and wine) into the body and blood of Christ

transubstantiated.definition:
v change (the Eucharist bread and wine) into the body and blood of Christ
v change or alter in form, appearance, or nature
transubstantiated.translation: v. 使变质( transubstantiate的过去式和过去分词 )

transubstantiates.definition:
v change (the Eucharist bread and wine) into the body and blood of Christ
v change or alter in form, appearance, or nature
transubstantiates.translation: v. 使变质( transubstantiate的第三人称单数 )

transubstantiating.definition:
v change (the Eucharist bread and wine) into the body and blood of Christ
v change or alter in form, appearance, or nature
transubstantiating.translation: v. 使变质( transubstantiate的现在分词 )

transubstantiation.definition: n. the Roman Catholic doctrine that the whole substance of the bread and the wine changes into the substance of the body and blood of Christ when consecrated in the Eucharist

transudates.definition:
plural of transudate
n a substance that transudes
transudates.translation: (transudate 的复数) 渗出液, 漏出物

transudation.definition:
n a substance that transudes
n the process of exuding; the slow escape of liquids from blood vessels through pores or breaks in the cell membranes
transudation.translation:
n. 渗出, 渗出物
[医] 漏出

transudatory.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to transudation; passing by
   transudation.
transudatory.translation:
a. 渗出的
[医] 漏出的

transude.definition: v release (a liquid) in drops or small quantities

transuded.translation: v. （使）渗出( transude的过去式和过去分词 )

transudes.definition: v release (a liquid) in drops or small quantities
transudes.translation: v. （使）渗出( transude的第三人称单数 )

transuding.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Transude
transuding.translation: v. （使）渗出( transude的现在分词 )

transuranic.definition: a. having an atomic number greater than 92

transuranic element.translation: [化] 超铀元素; 铀后元素

transuranic elements.translation:
[化] 超铀元素; 铀后元素
[医] 铀后元素, 超铀元素

transuranium.translation:
n. 超铀元素, 铀后元素
a. 超铀的, 铀后的

transuranium element.translation: [化] 铀后元素; 超铀元素

transuretero-ureteral anastomosis.translation: [医] 经输尿管两段吻合术

transurethral prostatectomy.translation: [医] 经尿道前列腺切除术

transurethral resection.translation: [医] 经尿道[前列腺]切除术

transurethral resection of the prostate.translation: [网络] 经尿道前列腺切除术；经尿道摄护腺切除术；经尿道摄护腺切除手术
